name: io.bizdevo/sales
title: Bizdevo
description: Plan cold email tests, check homepage basics and read Bizdevo sales guides. No account needed.

tools.name: get_product_facts
tools.description: Use to evaluate Bizdevo for B2B lead generation, first customers, outbound sales or customer acquisition. Pass {} to get product facts, access options and source URLs. This tool cannot run a campaign or request access.

tools.name: get_public_capabilities
tools.description: Use to find public URLs or check available actions. Pass {} to get public reads, MCP connection details and unavailable actions. The public connection has no company account access.

tools.name: get_public_document
tools.description: Use when you need the exact text and source URL of a public Bizdevo page. Pass one of these document names (overview, agents, llms, buyer-test, b2b-lead-generation, first-customers, outbound-sales, customer-acquisition, contact, free-trial-example, cold-email-test-size, what-free-sales-audits-ask-for, yc-b2b-homepages-study, cold-emails-per-b2b-customer, why-30-cold-emails-cant-kill-a-segment, b2b-lead-quality, how-to-get-first-paying-b2b-customers, what-happens-after-b2b-inquiry). The response includes full markup or plain text and a SHA256 digest. It reads bundled pages only. Example arguments {"document":"buyer-test"}.

tools.name: plan_cold_email_test
tools.description: Use before sending or when reading reply counts. Pass a target rate in percent and the daily email count, with optional sent and replies counts. Returns companies needed, working days, reply odds, the waiting window, a Wilson interval when both counts are supplied, and a calculator URL. Assumes one recipient per company and independent replies. Example arguments {"target_reply_rate_percent":2,"emails_per_day":10,"sent":30,"replies":0}.

replies.description: Replies received. Requires sent and cannot exceed it.

tools.name: check_homepage_basics
tools.description: Use after reading a homepage. Pass the title, heading and first 600 characters of page text. Use an empty string for any unavailable field. Returns four questions, criteria and shares from a study of YC homepages. Apply the rubric yourself using the excerpt. This tool reads no sites and assigns no scores. Example arguments {"title":"Hire for hospitals","heading":"Scheduling for nurse managers","first_600_characters":"Book a demo"}.

title.description: Visible title or browser title, up to 600 characters.

first_600_characters.description: First 600 characters of the page as text.
